NONE: › UK a sign meaning victory or peace that is made by holding up the first two fingers of one hand in the shape of a V, while the thumb and other fingers are folded down and face out
勝利手勢，V字形手勢，和平手勢（食指和中指伸開，手背朝內的手勢）
› UK offensive also two fingers a similar sign, made with the back of the hand facing out, used for expressing extreme dislike or anger towards someone
下流手勢（食指和中指伸開，手背朝外的手勢）

example: The driver shouted rudely at the cyclist and gave her a/the V-sign.
開車的人粗魯地對那個騎腳踏車的人大吼大叫，並朝她做了個下流的V字形手勢。
